messages.content:
So I'm actually going to do a 180 here and say this model is quite good! There are definitely still some issues with lane placement and it failed a cone test I did, but the upside was that it was the most "human" feeling and had a lot of confidence in what it chose to do. It was the first time where after having extended amount of time with a model, that I felt like it was the closest to how a friend might drive you around somewhere.

If this was something like a more general training process, it definitely felt more raw and more like it wasn't constrained to be stricly in the center and it really felt like it had more of a grounded human personality. 

Very cool! This may actually be my favourite exp long yet, and _feels_ like it would benfit the most from scaling up the model and scaling out the training data
Well you convinced me to switch back, and I agree, it feels very natural.
